assessment: In this paper 76 cryo-EM structures of recombinant tau filaments assembled in vitro are described. This is a scientific tour-de-force, and will provide an immense database that can be used by everyone working in the amyloid field. When this knowledge is combined with the structure of tau filaments in vivo, it will help shape the design of laboratory experiments in the future to generate the conditions to replicate the in vivo forms in vitro.
